asc_barman.text: Welcome to the Exiles. On Friday we have a quiz, and anyone is allowed to win, though the RAF has won more than their share. The question is always about somewhere far away.

asc_regular.text: I've been on Ascension eleven years. People ask if I miss England. I miss the weather, which is a thing you shouldn't miss, and sausage rolls that haven't travelled.
The club has a rule. Whoever turns up in the last month of their contract gets the first round. Hardly anyone has it fall on a Friday.
